Original PocketArch configurations by stunrelay, MIT. Source: https://github.com/stunrelay/PocketArch/tree/33dc23be7ea5938956bbe686c1c9494ef5628e30 . All 28 indexed configurations are reproduced unchanged in manifest.json, with SHA-256, sizes and dimensions of every indexed image. Images are fetched for CI only, never bundled in the application. Conversion output is an adaptation.
